name: cm-adversarial-audits
description: Before applying a plan or a non-trivial change, run a panel of independent, grounded adversarial auditors (distinct lenses), verify each finding against real code, and harvest only the confirmed ones. The auditor roster is a config option — the number of auditors is just how many names you list (e.g. Tom, Mary, Joan = 3). Toggle with /cm-audit-on and /cm-audit-off.
